RandomWalk.text:
# Random Walk

Rearrange the blocks so that:

- when the green flag is clicked, the screen is cleared, the cat goes to the origin (x=0, y=0).
- when Space is clicked, the cat goes to a random screen position, leaving a line drawn behind it
- when the cat is clicked, it glides back to the origin, then does one full 360 degree turn to the right.
